entities.name: Jared W. Williams
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jared Warner Williams was an American lawyer and politician from Lancaster, New Hampshire, who was a U.S. representative, the 21st governor of New Hampshire 1847 to 1849 and a United States senator.
